description: 1. Creates Huawei Cloud IAM users and authorizes them through the IAM v5 OpenAPI: create a user (name / description / enabled), create or reuse a user group, add the user to the group, and attach identity policies. 2. Execution order: KooCLI (`hcloud IAM <Operation>`) first, then the official `huaweicloudsdkiam` v5 Python SDK as a transparent fallback. Read-only lookups (list users / groups / policies) support name-to-id resolution. 3. Idempotent by design: an existing user/group is reused and an already-existing membership or attachment is reported instead of failing. 4. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: deleting or disabling users, deleting groups, AK/SK rotation, password policy, MFA, agencies/delegation. 5. Triggers include: "创建IAM用户", "IAM用户授权", "给用户授权", "关联用户组", "绑定权限策略", "IAM user create", "create IAM user", "authorize IAM user", "add user to group", "attach policy to user", "iam user manage".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
